# Switchboard

A terminal coding agent where the model is a slot, not a fixed property of the
tool. You configure a ladder of models, cheapest at the bottom. Before each user
turn, the deterministic router chooses the lowest suitable feasible rung; it
can move upward on evidence such as repeated tool calls, error spikes, new test
failures, or hedging. Every session is an append-only record that can be priced,
replayed, and searched. Free and open source (MIT), for macOS and Linux.

Version 1.1 adds deterministic per-turn routing, native Claude and Codex skill,
plugin, and MCP discovery, and explicit execution modes. Commands run without a
sandbox by default. Auto mode can send eligible ordinary commands to a
configured low-cost reviewer; shell, interpreter, sensitive, external, and
Windows commands remain human-approved. Yolo mode runs ordinary edits and
commands without prompts while keeping sensitive and external actions gated.
Verified Seatbelt or bubblewrap confinement is available when requested.
